subject: SIG delivery: PDF stamping, filename schema, and portal links
messages:
From: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@procurecorp.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: vendorops@procurecorp.com
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG delivery requirements + deadline

Hi Laura —

Thanks for moving quickly on this. Procurement needs a SIG package we can attach to the PO. To make our intake team happy please can you deliver a single consolidated PDF plus a small manifest. Requirements: 

- Single PDF (no >10MB) named exactly: SIG_ProcureCorp_Redwood_YYYYMMDD.pdf
- A separate CSV index mapping each SIG question to the supporting artifact filename (column headers: question_id, evidence_file)
- Signed cover letter (PDF) referencing our PO# 88012 (DocuSign link acceptable)
- Screenshots of the portal upload are helpful but optional
- OneTrust and Whistic are both accepted by our intake; please include both upload links if you upload to those portals

Deadline: procurement review opens 2026-07-21 09:00 PT. If you can deliver by end of day Monday (2026-07-20) that would be ideal. Also note we require that any SOC 2 report is redacted to remove customer account IDs.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if needed.

Sara Jenkins
Senior Buyer — ProcureCorp
Sourcing & Vendor Ops

Attachments: procurement-sig-requirements.pdf (procurecorp template)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@procurecorp.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG delivery requirements + deadline

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear checklist. We can do that by EOD Monday. Plan below: 

1) Consolidated PDF: we will generate a single PDF that contains: title page, signed cover letter (DocuSign), concatenated SIG answers, and embedded evidence thumbnails. PDF will include a small stamped footer on every page: "Redwood Inference — SIG package for ProcureCorp — generated 2026-07-20".

2) Evidence index CSV: will map to the file names inside the ZIP and the PDF appendix. We'll produce evidence-index.csv with columns question_id,evidence_file,evidence_type.

3) File naming: per your template we will name the primary file: SIG_ProcureCorp_Redwood_2026-07-20.pdf. Secondary artifacts will be in ZIP: SIG_ProcureCorp_Redwood_2026-07-20_artifacts.zip (contains soc2-redacted.pdf, infra-diagrams.pdf, cover-letter-signed.pdf, screenshots).

4) Portals: we will do a OneTrust upload and a Whistic intake. OneTrust requires a "Package Version" field — we'll set to v1.0 and include the DocuSign envelope ID in the metadata. We will send direct upload links back to you once complete.

Action items: 
- Sergio: can you produce a redacted SOC 2 PDF that removes AWS account IDs and any customer PII? We need it attached to the ZIP.
- Marissa: please capture a OneTrust upload screenshot and a short walk-through (3 screenshots max).

Attachments (drafts/stubs): 
- draft-sig-concat.pdf (stub for internal review)
- evidence-index-draft.csv
- cover-letter-template.pdf

If anything in ProcureCorp's list should change let me know now; otherwise we'll proceed and send upload links by 10:00 PT on 2026-07-20.

Thanks,

Laura Bennett
Head of Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0134

Attachments: draft-sig-concat.pdf (stub), evidence-index-draft.csv (stub), cover-letter-template.pdf

From: sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG delivery requirements + deadline

Laura — quick heads up on SOC 2.

On Mon, Jul 20, 2026 at 08:03 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> 1) Consolidated PDF: we will generate a single PDF that contains: title page, signed cover letter (DocuSign), concatenated SIG answers, and embedded evidence thumbnails.

I can produce the SOC 2 package but will need 1) confirmation to redact account IDs (ProcureCorp asked for this), and 2) a sign-off from legal on the final redaction. The current SOC file contains some AWS ARNs and two customer account identifiers that Procurement doesn't want shared. I will create soc2-redacted.pdf and mark the redaction log. Expect it by 09:30 PT.

Also: we should not paste the raw SOC attest report into OneTrust as the intake may prefer us to attach it in the ZIP and link in the PDF appendix (some customers keep the PDF internal). Will follow your lead on where to surface it.

Sergio Alvarez
Security & Compliance Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai

Attachments: soc2-redaction-log.txt (stub)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@procurecorp.com>, OneTrust Support <support@onetrust.com>, Whistic Intake <intake@whistic.com>

Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Completed: SIG package uploaded + DocuSign envelope

Hi Sara / OneTrust / Whistic —

Per ProcureCorp request, we've completed and uploaded the SIG package for your intake team. Summary below: 

What we delivered (attached & uploaded):
- SIG_ProcureCorp_Redwood_2026-07-20.pdf (single consolidated PDF; includes signed cover letter page and embedded evidence thumbnails)
- evidence-index.csv (maps SIG question IDs to artifact filenames)
- cover-letter-signed.pdf (DocuSign envelope ID: 0A1B2C3D4E5F6)
- soc2-redacted.pdf (SOC 2 report with account IDs redacted; redaction log retained internally)
- onetrust-upload-screenshot.png (screenshot of the OneTrust package summary page)

OneTrust upload: https://app.onetrust.com/upload/packets/abc123 (package ID: abc123)
Whistic intake link: https://app.whistic.com/intake/submit/xyz789
DocuSign envelope: https://na1.docusign.net/envelope/status/0A1B2C3D4E5F6

Notes: 
- Filename conventions follow ProcureCorp's template. Primary PDF is ~4.1MB. The ZIP with artifacts is available on request.
- We did not publish the raw SOC 2 to any public index; it is attached to the package and redacted per request.
- If procurement needs incremental changes (redaction adjustments, additional diagrams) we can produce a v1.1 package within 24 hours.

Next step: If this looks good, Sara, confirm you can see the OneTrust packet and we'll mark the procurement checklist item as "evidence received" on your side.

Best,

Laura Bennett
